aviation_incidents.headline: 土耳其空軍AS-532直升機訓練飛行墜毀、5名軍人罹難
aviation_incidents.summary: 根據土耳其國防部說法，這架直升機自土耳其西北部艾斯基瑟希爾省起飛執行訓練飛行，隨後墜毀。搜救隊伍在現場發現AS-532直升機殘骸，國防部確認機上5名軍人全部罹難，墜毀原因目前仍不明。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Turkish Air Force AS532 helicopter crashes on training flight, killing all five aboard
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Turkish Air Force helicopter crashed in northwestern Turkey on November 24 during a training flight, killing all five soldiers on board, according to the Turkish Defense Ministry. The helicopter had taken off in Eskisehir Province before coming down, and search and rescue teams found the wreckage of an AS532 helicopter at the scene. The ministry confirmed that all five soldiers aboard were killed, and the cause of the crash is not yet known.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 臺灣國防部通報偵獲1架共機及9艘共艦 國軍監控應處
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國防部表示，統計自11月24日上午6時起至25日上午6時的24小時期間，偵獲1架中國軍機侵擾臺灣東部空域，另偵獲9艘中國軍艦。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan defense ministry reports one Chinese military aircraft and nine warships
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected one Chinese military aircraft in airspace east of Taiwan during the 24 hours from 6 a.m. on Nov. 24 to 6 a.m. on Nov. 25. It also reported detecting nine Chinese warships during the same period.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 長榮航空首架客機進場改裝貨機，預計 2027 年投運
taiwan_aviation.summary: 長榮航空 11 月 25 日舉行線上法人說明會。中央社報導，長榮航表示首架由客機改裝的貨機已於 11 月中旬開始改裝，預計 2027 年投入營運。公司規劃第二架於 2027 年、第三架於 2028 年進場，分批擴充貨運機隊。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: EVA Air begins first passenger-to-freighter conversion, targets 2027 entry into service
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: EVA Air held an online investor briefing on November 25. According to Taiwan’s Central News Agency, the airline said its first passenger-to-freighter conversion began in mid-November and the aircraft is expected to enter service in 2027. A second aircraft is scheduled to enter conversion in 2027, followed by a third in 2028.

taiwan_aviation.summary_en: EVA Air received seven awards at the Taiwan Institute for Sustainable Energy’s ceremony on November 25. They included its first Global Corporate Sustainability Awards gold for sustainability reporting and a Taiwan Corporate Sustainability Awards platinum for its report.

international_aviation.headline: 美軍擬12月初恢復華盛頓國家機場附近直升機訓練飛行
international_aviation.summary: 美國陸軍計劃最快12月6日當週恢復華盛頓國家機場附近空域的直升機訓練飛行。相關訓練自2025年5月暫停，當時一架陸軍黑鷹直升機過於接近數架民航機；此舉距2025年1月29日陸軍黑鷹直升機與美國航空地區客機相撞造成67人罹難還不到兩年。陸軍尚未向美國聯邦航空總署正式提出申請，恢復計畫也面臨工會與部分國會議員的反對。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Army moves to resume helicopter training flights near Washington National Airport
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Army is moving to resume helicopter training flights in airspace near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA) as soon as the week of December 6, according to a recent report by Politico. Training operations in the corridor were halted in May 2025 after an Army Black Hawk came too close to several commercial aircraft, less than two years after a January 29, 2025 midair collision between an Army Black Hawk helicopter and an American Airlines regional jet killed 67 people. The Army has yet to submit a formal request for approval from the Federal Aviation Administration, and the move faces pushback from labor unions and some members of Congress.

international_aviation.headline: 挪威Norse Atlantic航空財務告急：須取得融資才能維持營運
international_aviation.summary: 挪威長程低成本航空公司Norse Atlantic航空11月25日在奧斯陸證交所發布內線消息公告，表示公司財務狀況危急，必須取得融資才能應付短期流動資金需求並繼續營運。
international_aviation.headline_en: Norse Atlantic Airways says its financial situation is critical, needs funding to keep flying
international_aviation.summary_en: Norwegian long-haul low-cost carrier Norse Atlantic Airways said in an inside-information announcement to the Oslo stock exchange on November 25 that its financial situation is critical and that it depends on securing financing to meet its short-term liquidity needs and continue operations.
